paragraphs.text: Vigorbloom is the School of Invasive Healing at Hexhaven Academy on the Echoverse version of Arcavios . It is aligned and the counterpart of Witherbloom . The founder of the school is Kwia Vigorbloom .
Kwia Vigorbloom founded the school and established three oaths:
I will serve a higher purpose than myself.
I will grow, heal, and strengthen the community.
I will ensure survival of the community through healing by any means necessary.

Vigorbloom mages can cultivate plants in any substrate and are tasked with the healing and care of the sick and injured. They implant plant materials directly into flesh to heal injuries and diagnose and cure ailments. Their botanical treatments regularly result in rapid healing. As they also experiment on themselves, many cadets have vines or plants growing out of their skin.

All Vigorbloom cadets are taught the basics of medicinal botany and first aid. Medicinal Botany is the least hands-on of any Vigorbloom course, focused on identifying plants and their healing uses, collection methods, and ideal grafting conditions. Some Vigorbloom mages known as sproutdruids specialize in hortimancy, working primarily as gardeners in the greenhouses to cultivate the best plants and pioneer new magical growing techniques. Becoming a weave medic or graft surgeon requires knowledge of plants, knowledge of patient anatomy, and skill with cultivation magic. Graft surgery involves the implantation of plant matter into a person, followed by growing the plant to facilitate the healing process. The most advanced phytomancy coursework at Vigorbloom teaches mages how to implant vegetation into opponents to cause injury. Training in aggressive healing is reserved for elite cadets who have demonstrated the moral grounding needed to ensure this magic is used properly. Vigorbloom cadets who fail to graduate can find employment as farmers.

Vigorbloom campus is dotted with dozens of greenhouses where seedlings and spores are cultivated and stored. Kwia's Nursery , the students' nickname for the largest greenhouse, consists of a central structure with hallways branching off to lab rooms. Most patient treatment takes place in the Invasive Care Infirmary , which contains multiple operating rooms, the largest of which is the Sowing Theater , which doubles as a lecture hall and operating theater. Patients recover in the Solarium Branches , where large windows ensure enough light allows the plants to take root in their hosts.
